stepTitle: $$(I-H)Y$$ is orthogonal to the column space of $$X$$
stepBody: When making predictions, Kippa computes $$\hat{Y}=X\hat{\theta}=X(X**{T}X)**{-1}X**{T}Y.$$ Let $$H=X(X**{T}X)**{-1}X**T$$ be the projection ('hat') matrix, so $$\hat{Y}=HY.$$ Let $$I$$ be the identity matrix with the same shape as $$H.$$\n\nIs this true about hat matrix $$H?$$ Select all that apply.
